page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 551 at top right. Two parallel columns of text: left column headed "Apud Ethnicos", right column headed "Apud Papistas"; below them a printed ornament (fleuron) centred. Faint show-through from the reverse page in the background, not transcribed.

main_text.l: pestis prænuncius, contra luem Gallicam, & defluvium capillorum, Venus:
Qui à daemoniis obsessi, à saltu S. Viti,

page.notes: Text in the left column is set in italic, with some words in black letter-like display type; the marks "à", "&" and the ligature "sine-bulofus" are read as printed. The right column's "Paulus conversus, sine-bulofus" is a hyphenated line end and is recorded as printed. Faint show-through of the other page is not transcribed. The fleuron below the columns is an ornament, not text.
